fixedPrefixForecast.scope: Extrapolation from the frozen 64,000-node prefix; excludes remaining passes, way/relation work, framing/final checks. Not measured national import time, a physical storage bound or an accuracy result.

compactIndexHypothesis.format: Ordered 64-bit node ID plus two exact signed 32-bit native coordinate integers, 16 payload bytes/record; losslessness not yet demonstrated.
compactIndexHypothesis.scope: Payload arithmetic only, not an index footprint or approved storage screen. Existing 1.5x forecast margin would reject two complete copies. Prototype bounded shard replacement to avoid two full concurrent indexes; all read-only retained assets and overhead still need accounting.

selectedDesign.firstPass: Fuse exact native metadata validation with batched compact coordinate writes; select highway ways and complete node dependencies generically against unchanged windows.
selectedDesign.secondPass: Materialize primary selected raw nodes, ways and relevant restrictions. Independently rebuild audit coordinate shards and recompute selection/membership/geometry from the source; no primary index reuse.
selectedDesign.auditIndependence: A primary node-ID set may only be a bounded materialization hint. Audit selection must be independently recomputed and exactly reconciled, with missing/extra IDs and raw-record/geometry drift rejected. Independent indexing and rolling shard replacement require adversarial controls before any large run.
selectedDesign.firstPrototype: Exact compact index, native validator/projection equivalence and batched writes on fixed bounded fixtures/saved samples, plus synthetic two-pass audit closure and storage/lifecycle bounds. Not a national extraction.

admissionBlockedBy: native coordinate integer/float losslessness and all metadata guards unproven
two-pass independent audit and complete selection/dependency equivalence unimplemented
lookup/header/shard storage, runtime and margins unmeasured
per-type row caps require a separately frozen count-backed revision; old full-import caps remain held
